title: John the Baptist
summary: Forerunner of Jesus (Luke 1). Jones dates his birth at 5 BC.
description: Son of Zacharias and Elisabeth. His father is not Zachariah king of Israel, and that priest has no record here. Jones, Appendix F, dates the birth. 3999 AM and 5 BC sum to 4004. NT/intertestamental Jones figure — scope pending Kevin’s ruling

sorting_basis.note: Tier 3: Ussher-Jones (Floyd Nolen Jones): 5 BC (no higher-tier year available).
